name: voice-ai-copilot
description: Kids Voice AI Copilot (Ages 5-12) with Multilingual Speech, Stories, Math & Science Learning Tutor

scripts.prepare-assets: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path'); fs.mkdirSync('www',{recursive:true}); fs.mkdirSync('www/js',{recursive:true}); fs.mkdirSync('www/css',{recursive:true}); fs.mkdirSync('www/audio',{recursive:true}); ['index.html','manifest.json','flow-diagram.html'].forEach(f=>{if(fs.existsSync(f)) fs.copyFileSync(f, 'www/'+f);}); fs.readdirSync('js').forEach(f=>fs.copyFileSync('js/'+f, 'www/js/'+f)); fs.readdirSync('css').forEach(f=>fs.copyFileSync('css/'+f, 'www/css/'+f)); if(fs.existsSync('audio')) fs.readdirSync('audio').forEach(f=>fs.copyFileSync('audio/'+f, 'www/audio/'+f)); console.log('Assets prepared in www/ directory.');"
scripts.sync: npm run prepare-assets && npx cap sync android
